title: adaptive_sf.py: Double-application of SNR/density SF adjustment
description: When assigned_sf is None and ema_loss > 0.25, the SNR/density check is applied twice: once in adaptive_sf_for_metrics (line 90-91 returns SF9 for density<5/snr>8) and again in select_tx_sf (line 139 decrements sf by 1). This causes SF to be 1 lower than spec requires. Example: density=3, snr=10, loss=0.3 returns SF9 but spec requires SF10.
close_reason: Fixed: When assigned_sf is None and ema_loss > 0.25, the code now resets sf to baseline (10) before applying pseudocode adjustments, avoiding double-application of the SNR/density decrement that was already in the table result. Verified with bug scenario: density=3, snr=10, loss=0.3 now correctly returns SF10.
